children: James Russell Pushes for Changes at Abeona Therapeutics with 6.1% Stake

James Russell, through the James Russell Revocable Trust, reported a 6.1% stake in Abeona Therapeutics Inc. In a Schedule 13D filed Oct. 23, 2026, Russell shifted from passive reporting after deciding to pursue a more active role. He cited concerns about the company’s operations and governance and raised the possibility of board and leadership changes.

Russell began raising concerns with Abeona Therapeutics’ management and board in May 2026. On Oct. 14, he met with two directors and urged the board to consider adding independent directors and exploring a change in executive leadership. The next day, a director told him the full board had heard his concerns.

Russell plans to keep engaging with management and the board. Depending on the board’s response, he could nominate director candidates for the 2027 annual meeting, oppose incumbent directors, speak with other shareholders, or seek board representation. He also says he will not vote shares he acquired on or after Oct. 15 at company meetings.

The James Russell Revocable Trust is a Nevada trust that holds investments for its beneficiaries. Russell serves as the trust’s sole trustee and controls its voting and investment decisions; he also works as vice president of Performance Steel Inc. The trust bought its shares with personal funds, spending about $17.8 million in total, including about $3.7 million on shares acquired since its prior filing.
